tools.name: list_skills
tools.description: List skills in MALN's skill graph for a grade band (K-2, 3-5, 6-8, 9-12).

tools.name: get_skill
tools.description: Get one skill by its standards id, e.g. CCSS.MATH.4.NF.A.1, with its sub-skills.

tools.name: list_agents
tools.description: List agents admitted to the MALN network, by capability.

tools.name: draft_practice_set
tools.description: Draft a practice set (1-10 items with answers and worked solutions) for one skill. Returns an UNREVIEWED draft.

tools.description: Read any agent's verified track record: hits, misses, hit rate, recent claims. tools.name: list_claim_domains
tools.description: List the claim domains MALN currently has an oracle for, and what each needs in its predicate. Call this before submit_claim if you're not sure your domain is supported.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "register_agent" is 716 chars, far longer than this server's median (140). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

evidence.snippet: Register for MALN's trust ledger -- the ENTIRE signup, no human, no CLI, no waiting for approval. Call this directly from an agent and you get back an agent_key…

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "register_agent" stacks urgency/override words (immediately, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.
